headword: {才能|さいのう}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す
gloss: to bring out someone's talent; to draw out ability

definitions.gloss: to bring out someone's talent; to draw out ability
definitions.explanation: To help someone discover or develop their latent abilities.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもの{才能|さいのう}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To bring out a child's talent.

examples.japanese: いい{先生|せんせい}は{生徒|せいと}の{才能|さいのう}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}せる。
examples.english: A good teacher can bring out a student's talent.

examples.japanese: あの{監督|かんとく}は{若|わか}い{選手|せんしゅ}の{才能|さいのう}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}すのがうまい。
examples.english: That coach is good at bringing out the talent of young players.

notes:
A common expression combining {才能|さいのう} (talent, ability) with {引|ひ}き{出|だ}す (to draw out, to pull out). The image is of talent being hidden inside a person and needing to be drawn out by a mentor, teacher, or environment. Frequently used in education and coaching contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隠|かく}れた{才能|さいのう}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す: to draw out hidden talent
- {最大限|さいだいげん}に{才能|さいのう}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す: to bring out talent to its fullest
- {才能|さいのう}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す{教育|きょういく}: education that draws out talent

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {力|ちから}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す: to draw out one's strength/ability
- {可能性|かのうせい}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す: to draw out one's potential
- {魅力|みりょく}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す: to bring out one's charm

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {才能|さいのう}を{伸|の}ばす: to develop talent — focuses on growth and nurturing over time
- {才能|さいのう}を{活|い}かす: to make use of talent — emphasizes applying existing talent effectively
